d:
Your body changes as you get older, but you can still build strength, mobility, and confidence at any age. Learn the simple habits and exercises that can help you stay active and fight back against the effects of aging.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
